BasePK: 2198876
Chunk index: 0

Speech chunk:
Mr. Speaker, yesterday in the course of the statement I made I referred to the fact that the meeting would be held on the 28th; next Monday, in any event. The meeting will be convened in Ottawa with the premiers or representatives of the three western provinces in order to have presented to the government the views of the governments of those provinces in respect of the question of abandonment, and the like. So far I have had an acceptance from two of the premiers; the third has not as yet replied whether or not that date will be satisfactory.
